deleteDialog.title: Delete Worker #{id}?
deleteDialog.hard: Hard delete physically removes this intent and the downstream nodes supported solely by it (cascading to the leaves to avoid orphaned data); shared nodes, goals, and the task's root facts are kept. This action is irreversible. The planner is notified of the deletion and re-plans accordingly.
deleteDialog.soft: Soft delete marks the intent as "deleted" and records the reason; the intent node, execution records, registered facts, and findings are all kept. The planner receives "intent deleted by user + reason" and re-plans accordingly.
deleteDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this intent is being deleted, e.g. wrong direction / goal obsolete / duplicate of another intent…

newSessionDialog.title: Start a new session?
newSessionDialog.description: The current session will be archived (you can switch back anytime) and the main agent continues with a clean context. The task's graph, assets, and goals are unaffected.

toasts.workerResumed: Worker #{id} resumed, waiting to be re-claimed
toasts.workerHardDeleted: Worker #{id} and its exclusive downstream were permanently deleted{extra}
toasts.workerSoftDeleted: Worker #{id} deleted (reason recorded; the planner will re-plan accordingly)
toasts.workerMessageSent: Message sent to Worker #{id}; execution resumed immediately
